lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters distributed across the mid-lateral flank, forming a regular matrix posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Transverse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the longitudinal rows of spots, creating a visible coordinate grid across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges along the upper lateral flank, characterized by a distinct linear shadow gradient with high intensity on the dorsal side of the ridge line.
